Profile.title: Style profile
Profile.intro: Tell us who lives here and what you like. This steers every design.
Profile.budgetHint: Rough total you want to spend on furniture, lighting and textiles per room.
Profile.noRooms: Add rooms first to set budgets.
Profile.quizIntro: Pick the room you like more. Skip if you like neither.
Profile.quizIncomplete: Answer at least {min} pairs with a real choice to complete the quiz.
Profile.mustKeepHint: Pieces you already own and want in the new design.
Profile.summary: Quiz {answered}/{total} · {missing, plural, =0 {all rooms have a budget} one {# room without budget} other {# rooms without budget}}
Profile.householdHint: Who lives here, and how the rooms get used.
Profile.colorsHint: Colours you want to see more of, and ones to keep out.

StyleDesc.scandinavian: Light woods, white walls, soft textiles, cosy and practical.
StyleDesc.japandi: Calm, low furniture, natural materials, muted earthy tones.
StyleDesc.mid_century: Tapered legs, walnut, curved shapes, warm accent colours.
StyleDesc.industrial: Metal, exposed brick, dark leather, raw concrete.
StyleDesc.modern_classic: Mouldings, symmetry, velvet and brass, refined neutrals.
StyleDesc.boho: Layered patterns, rattan, plants, warm and collected.
StyleDesc.minimal: Few pieces, clean lines, hidden storage, calm surfaces.
StyleDesc.mediterranean: Lime-washed walls, terracotta, blue accents, sunny.

Context.title: Context
Context.intro: What we derived about the apartment's surroundings. The design step uses all of this.
Context.locationUnknown: Location not found for this city. Check the city and country on the apartment.
Context.climateUnavailable: Climate data could not be loaded right now. Try again later.
Context.daylightHint: Estimated from window area, orientation, sun path and floor level.
Context.renterOwner: You own this apartment, so there are no renter restrictions.
Context.trendsNone: No trends researched yet for this country and style.
Context.trendsNeedProfile: Finish the style quiz first, so trends can match your style.
Context.trendsCost: Uses Claude with web search: takes up to a minute and costs a few cents. Results are cached for 90 days.
Context.warn_noLocation: Location unknown: daylight uses a default sun model and there is no climate data.
Context.warn_noProfile: No style profile: trends and design will be generic.

Design.title: Design
Design.costNote: Uses Claude (Sonnet 5 by default, Opus 5 for the last repair): about a minute per room and roughly 15 cents. Every result is checked by the validator, with up to 3 automatic repair rounds.
Design.stage_fixing: Asking for a small fix (round {attempt} of {max})…
Design.none: No design yet for this room.
Design.dropped: {count, plural, one {One piece did not fit and was left out} other {# pieces did not fit and were left out}}: {items}.
Design.droppedCap: The room is too small for more pieces, so the least important ones were left out.
Design.tooSmall: This room may simply be too small for the requested furniture. Try fewer or smaller pieces.
Design.banner_valid: All geometry and design rules pass.
Design.banner_valid_with_warnings: No errors. Some recommendations below are not met.
Design.banner_invalid: This design still breaks rules after the automatic repairs. It is not a final design: see the problems below and generate again.
Design.prereqProfile: No style profile or no budget for this room: the design will be generic.
Design.planHint: Tap an item to highlight it. Red outlines mark items with errors.
Design.tooSmallHint: The room may be too small for these pieces.
Design.connectionLost: Connection lost. If the design finished, reload the page.

NewRoom.title: A new room
NewRoom.meta: Name it and type its size
NewRoom.name: Room name
NewRoom.sizeHint: Measure wall to wall at floor level. You can refine the shape and add doors and windows in the planner.
NewRoom.budgetHint: Furniture, lighting and textiles for this room.
NewRoom.budgetNoProfile: Budgets are kept in the style profile. Start it to set one for this room.
NewRoom.sketchEmpty: Type a width and length to see the room.
NewRoom.areaHint_living: A sofa, a coffee table and a clear 90 cm path need about 12 m².
NewRoom.areaHint_bedroom: A comfortable bedroom fits a 160 cm bed with 60 cm on both sides.
NewRoom.areaHint_kitchen: Leave 120 cm between facing counters so two people can pass.
NewRoom.areaHint_bath: Keep 70 cm clear in front of the basin and the toilet.
NewRoom.areaHint_office: A desk needs about 100 cm behind it to pull the chair back.
NewRoom.areaHint_hallway: Hallways feel open from about 110 cm wide.
NewRoom.areaHint_dining: A table for four needs roughly 3 × 3 m with chairs pulled out.
NewRoom.areaHint_kids: Leave a free play area of at least 2 m² on the floor.
NewRoom.areaHint_storage: Shelves 40 cm deep leave the most usable floor.
NewRoom.areaHint_other: Area inside the walls, measured at floor level.
